note: Both sets contain the same four claims with the same values, conditions and quotes, differing only in how the attribute label is written for one claim (A includes '(θ =0º)' in the attribute name as well as the conditions field). Both sets bind the pitch sensitivity and θK values to a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' entity that is not supported by the page, and both duplicate the θK = 6.302336º claim under two different entities. Neither set captures the definition of θK (the angle at which pitch sensitivity doubles) or the NREL 5-MW / Region 3 context, so the omissions and misbindings are equal.
